name: Dawn Regalia (Draknava signature)
description: an ornate floor-length dawn gown of {{PRIMARY}} and gossamer-silver silk with a fitted bodice embroidered with {{METAL}} feathers and swirling wind-lines, a high collar of layered feather-cut plates, long sleeves of sheer silver gauze, and a skirt of layered scarves and streaming ribbons that spiral upward around her; sweetheart neckline
notes: Worn in the Dawn scene: a highly decorative, flowing gown built to move while rising from the Sundering.
